bar.name: M49's all-three bar
bar.interval: paired percentile bootstrap over the queries, 2000 resamples, seed 0, alpha 0.05 (app/eval/stats.py defaults, as M43)
bar.words: app.eval.report.verdict on the lo and hi stored in the results file (rounded to four decimals): 'above zero' if and only if lo > 0; 'below zero' if and only if hi < 0; 'covers zero' otherwise, including a stored lo or hi of exactly 0.0000

datasets.fixture: fixture v1, the held-out (test) half of app.eval.rerank_arms.split_questions (n 68); the tune half and all 136 are reported beside it, nothing is chosen on either

roles.a: hybrid@<tag> vs hybrid@bge-small: BM25 plus the MaxSim leg in place of bge-small, RRF k 60, equal weights (fixture retrieve_k 50, BEIR k 100)
roles.b: hybrid+<tag>@bge-small/fp32-doc<L>/top20 vs hybrid@bge-small: MaxSim reranks the fused top 20 (fixture: of the fused top 50, the tail in fused order; BEIR: of the fused top 100)

bar.pass: PASS if the model's bar comparison in that role is above zero on all three datasets
bar.not_pass: NOT PASS if it covers zero or is below zero on at least one dataset, with the triple written out; a loss on any dataset is written as a loss
bar.open: OPEN if at least one dataset is measured, none covers zero or is below zero, and at least one dataset has no row (its part did not finish, or could not before 2026-12-15); OPEN is never a pass. A model that loaded but has no row on any dataset is 'not measured: no row finished before 2026-12-15'
bar.secondary: dense@<tag> vs dense@bge-small (fixture: dense_only@), the leg alone: reported with its verdict, outside the bar
bar.references: each named role-(b) row vs hybrid+bge-rerank, hybrid+minilm-l12 and hybrid+gte-modernbert-base@bge-small/fp32-512/top20, recomputed in the same (primary) part: outside the bar

plan_row_4_2.pass: measured: `<model>` passes in role (a|b) (claims) ...; against `gte-modernbert-base` (claims) ...; not on the default path: adopting it is an owner decision after the serving bar on the host
plan_row_4_2.no_pass: measured, not adopted: no named model at its saved settings passes the all-three bar in either role (claims); the MaxSim code stays as a measured, tested option off the default path
plan_row_4_2.open: appends: the bar is open for `<model>` in role (a|b): <dataset> not measured (<reason>)
plan_row_4_2.sensitivity_or_stretch_all_three: appends: `<row>` (sensitivity or stretch, outside the declared bar) is above zero on all three datasets; the verdict is unchanged
plan_row_4_2.demo: labelled a demo only if NO named model can be measured (both fail to load or the fidelity checks, or no GPU row can finish before 2026-12-15), naming the failed check's output, the job id and the NOTES entry
plan_row_4_2.one_measured: if one named model is measured and the other is not, the row is 'measured' for the measured model, its nine plan-flagged claims only, the other named as 'not measured: <reason>'
plan_row_4_2.not_measured_means: only a load failure, a failed fidelity check, or no row of that model finishing on any dataset before 2026-12-15; rows that loaded, passed the checks and scored are never withdrawn

settings.primary_document_length: each model's saved setting: CANDIDATES[tag]['saved']['document_length'] (300 answerai, 180 colbertv2)
settings.doc512_override: the backbone Transformer module's document_length, set after loading, read back and asserted; the run records the longest document's token count to show it took effect
settings.query_side: the model's own markers and query expansion; no instruction or prompt beyond those markers

document_text.fixture: chunk.text, exactly what bge-small's dense leg reads (BM25 also reads search_context)
document_text.beir: title + ' ' + text from app.eval.beir.load_corpus, as the parent

scoring.role_a: maxsim_scores: one batched float64 pass per token store and query set, scores rounded to 10 decimals (DENSE_SCORE_DECIMALS), ranked with hybrid.rank_by_score (ties in corpus order)
scoring.role_b: app.multimodal.late_interaction.maxsim per (query, candidate), candidates encoded on the fly per query; stable sort, ties keep the fused order

fixture.candidates: the fused top 50 chunks, the first 20 reranked, the tail in fused order

beir.candidates: the fused top 100 documents, the first 20 reranked

settings.device_order: Turing first (-p gpu,eecs --constraint 'rtx8000|rtx2080'); an A40 only if neither started 12 h after submission

answerai-colbert-small.why: 33M parameters, the size of the parent bge-small and of the MiniLM-L12 cross-encoder

colbertv2.why: the 2021 reference model of late interaction

gte-moderncolbert.why: chosen as the strongest current open English ColBERT model (a selection on published BEIR scores)

mxbai-edge-colbert-17m.why: the size that could serve on a CPU

multiplicity.per_pass: each PASS is an intersection-union test: three one-sided tests, each at 2.5% (the lower end of a 95% two-sided interval above zero); its false-PASS rate is at most about 2.5% per (model, role)
multiplicity.row_4_2: row 4.2 moves on a union, 'at least one named model passes in at least one role': four named PASS claims give at most 10% for any false PASS (union bound), or at most 20% if the four stretch PASS claims are also reported as findings
multiplicity.bar_words: the twelve per-dataset bar words are uncorrected 95% intervals: if every true effect were zero and the tests independent, about 46% of runs (1 - 0.95^12) would show at least one 'above zero' or 'below zero' word by chance
multiplicity.others: every other interval is uncorrected too: the reference, secondary, sensitivity and stretch comparisons add 69 nDCG@10 intervals (23 per dataset: 11 in the primary part, 12 in the extra part) beside the 12 bar intervals, before the tune and all-136 scopes and before recall and MRR; each results file states its own count

this_file.uncorrected: every interval of this file is an uncorrected 95% interval; the Bonferroni column of the bar rows is reported, never deciding

card_claim.card_line: If you're interested in using this model as a re-ranker (it vastly outperforms cross-encoders its size!), you can do so via the [rerankers](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/rerankers) library:
card_claim.supported: 'supported here' only if the row is above zero against the comparator on all three datasets
card_claim.contradicted: 'contradicted on <datasets>' if it is below zero against the comparator on at least one dataset
card_claim.not_shown: 'not shown' otherwise, including a missing dataset
card_claim.excluded: the doc512 rows are sensitivity rows and are not part of this reading
caveats: the comparator was chosen by parameter count while its rows were already known to be weak: its held-out row against the parent in bench/results/small_rerankers.json is below zero
unequal budgets: the MaxSim reranker reads 300 document tokens (answerai's saved length); the cross-encoder reads 512 tokens of query plus document

published.note: other implementations; ColBERTv2's with approximate (PLAID) search; not every setting is stated: a tripwire, never a bar

low.below_bm25: below the nDCG@10 of the committed bm25 row of bench/results/beir_scifact.json, read from that file at run time

tripwire.truncation_explained: a low trip of a model whose saved document length is below 512, whose dense@<tag>/doc512 SciFact row neither low-trips nor high-trips, is 'truncation-explained' and does not stop FiQA; a high trip has no exception; no exception if the doc512 row is missing
tripwire.fixture_trip: if the run's counts show no fixture chunk cut at a model's primary document length, its primary and doc512 fixture rows (dense_only, hybrid and role b) must have equal ranking sha256s, row by row; a difference trips, no exception

answerai-colbert-small.stated: MS MARCO triplets, by the JaColBERTv2.5 recipe (artifact.metadata: triples, collection and queries under msmarco/)
answerai-colbert-small.source: artifact.metadata and the model card at the pinned revision

colbertv2.stated: MS MARCO Passage Ranking (the card: 'trained on the MS MARCO Passage Ranking task'; artifact.metadata: MSMARCO triples and collection)
colbertv2.source: the model card and artifact.metadata at the pinned revision

gte-moderncolbert.stated: knowledge distillation on MS MARCO (lightonai/ms-marco-en-bge-gemma), the card; the card's NanoSciFact and NanoFiQA2018 rows are evaluations
gte-moderncolbert.source: the model card at the pinned revision

mxbai-edge-colbert-17m.stated: not stated on the card, which cites its tech report ('Fantastic (small) Retrievers and How to Train Them'), not read here
mxbai-edge-colbert-17m.source: the model card at the pinned revision

bge-small.stated: MTEB's training-data annotation of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (bge_training_data, from BAAI-MTP): NQ, NQHardNegatives, AmazonReviewsClassification, MLQARetrieval, DuRetrieval, and pretraining pairs not in MTEB (wudao, cmrc2018, simclue, csl, amazon_reviews_multi, wiki_atomic_edits, mlqa, xlsum, wikipedia, reddit, stackexchange, s2orc); neither SciFact nor FiQA; the annotation itself marks the sentence-transformers data as not checked
bge-small.corpus_note: s2orc (title, abstract) pairs: SciFact's corpus is S2ORC abstracts, so the parent may have read SciFact documents (not its claims or labels)

bge-rerank.stated: the card: 'a mixture of multilingual datasets': bge-m3-data, quora train data, fever train data; MTEB's annotation of bge-m3's data (bge_m3_training_data): MIRACL, Mr.TyDi, MS MARCO, NQ, HotpotQA, T2, DuRetrieval, CodeSearchNet and others, with s2orc among the pretraining data; neither SciFact nor FiQA
bge-rerank.corpus_note: s2orc in bge-m3's pretraining: it may have read SciFact documents (not its claims or labels)

minilm-l12.stated: MS MARCO Passage Ranking (the card; datasets: sentence-transformers/msmarco)

gte-modernbert-base.stated: not listed on the card, which refers to the mGTE paper's training scheme, not read here

stretch_status.gte-moderncolbert: loaded; settings, load-and-score and the card's fingerprint passed
stretch_status.mxbai-edge-colbert-17m: loaded; settings, load-and-score and the card's fingerprint passed

late_interaction.expected_reproduction: Expected, declared before any run (not defects): on a Turing GPU (RTX 8000 or 2080 Ti) FiQA's recomputed rankings equal the committed Turing rows; on an A40, FiQA's dense@bge-small, hybrid@bge-small and bge rows give ranking_equal false against beir_fiqa.json (adjacent near-tie swaps, equal metrics, M41); on SciFact the bge row's ranking differs between files of different GPU architectures. Retrieval-block equality is the criterion everywhere.
does_not_show: a PLAID or compressed index: this is exhaustive, uncompressed MaxSim, the exact score PLAID-style search approximates; not ANN latency at scale; storage is for uncompressed vectors
that it serves: no pgvector MaxSim, no served path; HPC timings are indicative; the serving bar on the host is not decided here; the image's sentence-transformers is 6.3, 6.1 here
equivalence or 'no effect': a NOT PASS, and an interval that covers zero, is not evidence of equivalence; each dataset's paired half-width is the rough smallest gain that could have passed
first-stage recall on the fixture: role (a) ranks 71 chunks with retrieve_k 50, so the fixture's Recall@50 sits beside its random baseline and is no recall claim
results free of selection: the models were chosen knowing their published BEIR scores, which include SciFact and FiQA; only the fixture is free of that
a level field: RRF k 60, retrieve_k, the reranking depth and the 512 budget were set around bge-small; the MaxSim legs are not re-tuned
equal budgets in role (b): MaxSim reads 180 or 300 document tokens (512 in the sensitivity rows), the cross-encoders 512 of query plus document
fine-tuned or domain-adapted ColBERT: zero-shot only
that BEIR is free of training contamination: it cannot be checked from outside
answer quality or the real corpus: retrieval metrics only; the fixture is small (68 held-out questions), templated and judged by file
ColPali pages or image retrieval (PLAN rows 4.1, 4.3 and 4.4 unchanged)
late interaction in general: two named models at their saved settings plus one 512 sensitivity length, and two stretch models

_rule.pre_filter: before run_config drops did == qid (BEIR's ignore-identical-ids); the rederive applies it after fusion
